text: A modal opened with E at your own team's barracks panel (within 2.6 m) that lists Squad classes, Vehicles, Special Weapons and the frag grenade, each row with tier, HP, price (with a power-down warning and an 'offline, prices doubled' banner) and a button driven by the status functions (Active/Buy/Equip/Tier N/Locked/Full). While the shop is open the game update is paused, and grenade charge, mouse fire and the Tab scoreboard are blocked; E or Escape closes it. It re-renders after each purchase or class pick and when you level up or your team eras up; buying a vehicle or equipping a special weapon closes it.

Per-weapon kill counts credit the weapon in hand when the kill event is processed (onKill(curW().id) at :1536; the damage event carries no weapon), so a frag-grenade kill (blast from the player's id at :1775) is counted for the held gun.

text: Builds US-Army-style rank insignia (18 tiers in RANK_TIERS :1959-1978: plain, chevrons, rockers, stars, bars, oak leaf, eagle, general's stars) and 10 prestige medals (PRESTIGE :2050-2061) as procedural SVG strings
The insignia is also drawn on the scoreboard.

Unused gun-game progression (rifleKills, rifleLevel, RIFLE_TIERS, tierBase, advanceAt) and its pip display, which is built but always hidden; a rank label that updateRank fills with curW().tier, a field no weapon has, so it is always empty; an unused ROMAN table; the unused core tunables incomeBase/incomeRefinery; the 'friend'/'hostile' keys of teamEco and TEAM_COL, which nothing reads (every lookup uses TEAMS ids); the vanguard_prog fallback key; a career-chip pop element and an XP-pop timer that are looked up or declared but never used. Not dead: teamOf's mapping of the map-data team names 'friend'/'hostile' to allies/soviets, which legacy map data still uses.
